description:
Cast Spider-Byte by paying its mana cost.
Dancing from Dark to Dawn's first ability triggers, putting three +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Spider-Byte spell. When it enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{U}.
Repeat.
